_comment: Hand-authored PTDL_v2 egg for Project Reclaimer. Generated by tools/build_egg.py from scripts/install.sh; do not hand-edit the 'script' field below without also updating scripts/install.sh.
name: Project Reclaimer
author: nouhmaybe@users.noreply.github.com
description: Community-developed Halo 3 dedicated multiplayer server (Project Reclaimer), run via a thin Pterodactyl-compatibility wrapper around the official ghcr.io/projectreclaimer/project-reclaimer-dedicated image. Requires your own legally-owned Halo 3 (MCC) game files; none are included. See https://projectreclaimer.dev/host for upstream documentation and https://github.com/NoUhMaybe/Project-Reclaimer-Pterodactyl-Egg for this egg.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Project Reclaimer — Pterodactyl install script.
#
# Runs once per install/reinstall inside a throwaway installer container
# (ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/installers:debian), with /mnt/server bound to the
# server's real persistent directory. Anything NOT under /mnt/server here
# is discarded once this script exits; only /mnt/server survives into the
# runtime container as /home/container.
#
# This script never downloads or generates Halo 3 game files, and never
# touches dedicated.toml (that is generated idempotently by configure.py on
# every container start instead, see docker/entrypoint.sh) so that a
# reinstall never clobbers an admin's hand-edited configuration.

set -euo pipefail

echo "-----------------------------------------------------------"
echo " Project Reclaimer — Pterodactyl install script"
echo "-----------------------------------------------------------"

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server/server"

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
    echo "ERROR: $SERVER_DIR does not exist (expected Pterodactyl install mount)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

cd "$SERVER_DIR"

echo "Creating persistent directory skeleton..."
mkdir -p \
    "$SERVER_DIR/game/halo3/maps" \
    "$SERVER_DIR/content/Maps" \
    "$SERVER_DIR/content/Game Modes" \
    "$SERVER_DIR/content/Mods" \
    "$SERVER_DIR/playlists" \
    "$SERVER_DIR/data"

# bans.json is shared/authoritative state; never overwrite an existing one
# on reinstall.
if [ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/bans.json" ]; then
    echo '{"players": [], "ips": [], "vpn_allowed": []}' > "$SERVER_DIR/bans.json"
    echo "Created empty bans.json"
else
    echo "bans.json already exists, leaving it untouched"
fi

# A short, always-overwritable pointer file (not configuration, so safe to
# refresh on every install) explaining what the admin still needs to do.
cat > "$SERVER_DIR/UPLOAD_GAME_ASSETS_HERE.txt" <<'EOF'
Project Reclaimer requires your own legally-owned copy of Halo 3 from
Halo: The Master Chief Collection. No game files are included with this
egg or with Project Reclaimer itself.

Upload the following into this server's "server/game" folder via SFTP
or the Pterodactyl File Manager, preserving the folder structure shown:

  server/game/halo3/halo3.dll                     (required)
  server/game/halo3/maps/shared.map               (required)
  server/game/halo3/maps/<MapName>.map            (one per map you want to host)
  server/game/halo3/maps/campaign.map             (optional: Forge campaign vehicles/AI)
  server/game/halo3/maps/040_voi.map              (optional: Forge campaign vehicles/AI)

See INSTALL.md in the egg repository for the full, up to date list and
step-by-step instructions, including how to copy these files from a
Windows PC with the game installed using `project-reclaimer.exe dedicated
init --from`.

The server will refuse to start (with a clear error in the console) until
halo3.dll and shared.map are present.
EOF

echo "-----------------------------------------------------------"
echo " Directory skeleton ready under $SERVER_DIR"
echo " dedicated.toml will be generated automatically on first start."
echo " Remember to upload your Halo 3 game files before starting the"
echo " server — see UPLOAD_GAME_ASSETS_HERE.txt in the file manager."
echo "-----------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The server's name, shown in the Server Browser. Required and unique, up to 48 characters.

variables.name: Community Name
variables.description: Optional text shown beneath the server's name in the Server Browser (dedicated.toml host_name).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum players admitted at once (1-127, split-screen counted). Campaign co-op is capped at 16 by upstream regardless of this value.

variables.name: Min Players
variables.description: Players the server waits for in its lobby before a playlist vote or automatic start begins (1-MAX_PLAYERS).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional password players must enter to join. Leave blank for an open server. Separate from the RCON password.

variables.name: Publicly Listed
variables.description: When enabled, the server reports to the public master server list (Server Browser). Disable to require Direct Connect.

variables.name: Playlist
variables.description: Path (relative to the server folder) to a playlist file to run, e.g. playlists/community.playlist.json. Upload the file first. Leave blank to use Map/Game Type below, or upstream's Slayer-on-Guardian default if those are also blank.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Base map name to host when Playlist is blank, e.g. Guardian. Ignored if Playlist is set.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: Game mode to host when Playlist is blank, e.g. Slayer. Ignored if Playlist is set.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Let the server update Project Reclaimer itself on start and hourly (does not update this Docker image or MCC). Interrupts games in progress when it updates.

variables.name: Enable RCON
variables.description: Turn on the password-protected remote console. Requires RCON Password to also be set.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for the remote console (8-128 characters). RCON stays disabled while this is blank, even if Enable RCON is on. RCON is unencrypted: prefer an SSH tunnel or VPN to reach it, see TROUBLESHOOTING.md.

variables.name: Anti-Cheat
variables.description: enforce kicks on detected cheating (default), detect only logs, off disables protection.

variables.name: Block VPN / Proxy Connections
variables.description: Refuse players connecting through a known VPN, proxy or hosting provider.
